alias: Home Context - Approve Denon Music Lighting
description: Manual-only, bounded approval path. Changes Family Room Lights only when a person approves an evening, high-confidence, Denon-verified music suggestion while the Family Room is occupied AND the ai_actions_enabled safety gate is ON. While the gate is OFF it records the approval as feedback but changes nothing. It never enables automatic actions.

choose.alias: Eligible Denon music suggestion - actions gate ON

sequence.alias: Apply warm, low-brightness Family Room lighting

data.value: Approved: applied warm Family Room lighting for the current Denon-verified music session.
Music lighting was applied by your approval. It will not repeat unless you approve a new suggestion.

choose.alias: Approved but AI Actions safety gate is OFF
choose.note: Records the approval for accept-rate measurement (Phase 3) without controlling any device. This is the observe-only default until accuracy is proven and ai_actions_enabled is deliberately turned on.

data.value: Approval logged, but AI Actions is OFF (safety gate). No device was changed. Turn on AI Actions to allow approved lighting.
Approval received, but the Denon music suggestion was no longer eligible (needs evening, occupied Family Room, verified music, high confidence). No lighting was changed.
